scope: Same synthetic development data; three actual preprocessing models; native representations where exposed. Not a claim of independent accuracy or equivalent model capabilities.

method.tfidf: Production preprocessing, strict actual model; per-student TF-IDF (1,3), min_df=1, sublinear_tf=True; cosine similarity.
method.native: spaCy raw Doc.vector over exact generated descriptions, then cosine. Medium uses mean static word vectors. Small uses mean contextual tok2vec features, an exploratory diagnostic NOT a trained sentence-similarity model. No stopword/metadata removal or post-result tuning. Stanza tokenize/lemma does not expose an equivalent document embedding.
method.hybrid: 0.60 category + 0.25 NLP + 0.15 neutral location (0.5). Negative native cosine clipped to zero for the hybrid only; NLP-only ranking retains raw cosine. Stable ascending position ID for ties.

models.native_note: Configured tokenize/lemma pipeline has no document similarity vector API. No substitute model or fabricated native score is used.

integrity_checks: Same dataset/generator hashes as earlier run
Label permutation does not affect inputs
Prior completed spaCy TF-IDF metrics reproduced exactly
No fallback; no zero/nonfinite native vectors accepted
